mapper.select: select n.id, n.file_task_id, n.target_type, n.target_user_id, n.recipient_count, n.title, n.status, n.sender_user_id, n.send_time, n.withdraw_user_id, n.withdraw_time, coalesce( (select ai.real_name from auth_info ai where ai.user_id = n.sender_user_id and ai.del_flag = '0' and ai.auth_status = '5' order by ai.auth_time desc, ai.auth_id desc limit 1), sender.nick_name, sender.user_name ) as sender_name, coalesce( (select ai.real_name from auth_info ai where ai.user_id = n.withdraw_user_id and ai.del_flag = '0' and ai.auth_status = '5' order by ai.auth_time desc, ai.auth_id desc limit 1), withdrawer.nick_name, withdrawer.user_name ) as withdraw_user_name from file_task_notification n left join sys_user sender on sender.user_id = n.sender_user_id left join sys_user withdrawer on withdrawer.user_id = n.withdraw_user_id where n.file_task_id = #{taskId} order by n.send_time desc, n.id desc

select n.*, coalesce( (select ai.real_name from auth_info ai where ai.user_id = n.sender_user_id and ai.del_flag = '0' and ai.auth_status = '5' order by ai.auth_time desc, ai.auth_id desc limit 1), sender.nick_name, sender.user_name ) as sender_name, coalesce( (select ai.real_name from auth_info ai where ai.user_id = n.withdraw_user_id and ai.del_flag = '0' and ai.auth_status = '5' order by ai.auth_time desc, ai.auth_id desc limit 1), withdrawer.nick_name, withdrawer.user_name ) as withdraw_user_name from file_task_notification n left join sys_user sender on sender.user_id = n.sender_user_id left join sys_user withdrawer on withdrawer.user_id = n.withdraw_user_id where n.file_task_id = #{taskId} and n.id = #{notificationId}
mapper.update: update file_task_notification set status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdraw_user_id = #{withdrawUserId}, withdraw_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where file_task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{notificationId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select id, file_task_id, title, send_time from file_task_notification where file_task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and find_in_set(#{userId}, recipient_user_ids) order by send_time desc, id desc
